timeline.message: Energy & City Control Threat. Synthetic attack telemetry injected into the city twin.
Traffic controller sent 26 unauthorized service-stop requests to the edge compute plane.
Unauthorized service-stop commands attempt to disrupt the edge services supporting energy and city control. This is an Enterprise mapping for the compute layer, not a full ICS assessment.
Calculating downstream exposure from the compromised asset.
2 critical services are reachable through enabled dependency links. Peak risk 72/100 combines asset criticality, exposure, graph distance, link trust and current protection.
Selecting a service-preserving containment strategy.
Preserve critical service availability before changing endpoint or segment access. Context checks, service rerouting and containment are ordered and policy validated.
Validating simulation scope, service routes and isolation boundaries.
Shared edge-segment isolation affects multiple tenants. Explicit approval is required; all critical service routes pass the safety dry-run.
Approve shared edge-segment isolation, or reject to use endpoint-only containment.
Operator: reject for plan v1.
Rejected segment action removed. Version 2 protects services and quarantines only the source.
SIMULATED NETWORK-AS-CODE ACTIONS · local deterministic provider.
POST /device/location/verify · Traffic Controller
Location verified · city-zone
POST /sim-swap/check · Traffic Controller
No suspicious SIM change · low identity risk
POST /routes/reroute · Energy Grid
Energy Grid moved to protected transport
POST /routes/reroute · Smart-City Control
Smart-City Control moved to protected transport
POST /qod/sessions · Energy Grid
Energy Grid priority active · 45 → 8 ms (simulated)
POST /slice/isolate · Traffic Controller
Traffic Controller quarantined
Source isolated; residual propagation risk 0/100; all six critical services remained online.
Compiling evidence, approval history, actions and continuity measurements.
Incident reports generated from actual state. Ready to review or export JSON.
City twin reset. The incident record and reports remain in local history.
